en: Black‑and‑white printed view over a historic Middle Eastern/North African city with flat-roofed buildings, domes, and a tall minaret. In the foreground stands a fortified complex with crenellated walls and several domed structures, while a dense urban area stretches into the background. A French caption at the bottom reads "Alexandrie. Vue générale." and there is a small number at the lower left. A website watermark "www.elia.org.gr" appears over the image.
